race.description: More From Tote With Ladbrokes Hcp (65)
race.comment: MILLENNIUM BLADE (5) has changed stables since his last start in far stronger company at Caulfield in March. He has had a couple of quiet trials to get ready for his return, and at this level from a good draw, with the aid of a 3kg claim, he goes on top for us. NO FOOLING (6) made his Queensland debut from the powerful Tony Gollan stable, and finished off his race strongly for fourth. He slots into the pole position this time, and with less weight to carry, he can have the last say. BOSS MODE (1) is a promising 4YO gelding who resumed in great shape to score here by a head nearly 3 weeks ago. He carries half a kilo less after a claim, and can take the net step immediately. DIVINE SOURCE (11) is a talented mare who resumes with a recent easy trial win here under her belt. She has won fresh up in the past, and is set to give this a big shake. SORT CHA MESS (9) has yet to miss a cheque in 6 career starts, and capped off his good recent form with an easy Moree win. Stick with him.
